Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Company Description q.beyond is a leading IT partner for small and medium-sized enterprises across Europe, helping customers solve complex technological challenges and future-proof their business models. The company delivers sovereign IT solutions powered by proprietary, certified AI data centers, with a strong focus on public and private clouds, Microsoft and SAP-based business-critical applications, artificial intelligence, and IT security. More than 1,000 specialists combine sector-specific know-how with deep technical expertise to create sustainable business value for clients. q.beyond is publicly listed and operates locations across Germany as well as in Latvia, Spain, Romania, India, and the USA.
 Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Cluj-Napoca for a German-speaking IT Operations / System Administrator. The role involves monitoring and maintaining servers, networks, and business-critical systems to ensure high availability and performance. Responsibilities include handling incident and problem management, performing system updates and backups, managing user accounts and access rights, and supporting the rollout of new services and technologies. The IT Operations / System Administrator will provide technical support in German and English, collaborate closely with colleagues in Romania and other q.beyond locations, and document procedures and configurations according to internal standards and compliance requirements.
 Qualifications
Strong System Administration skills, including server management, operating systems configuration, and routine maintenance.
Experience in Troubleshooting and Technical Support to diagnose, analyze, and resolve incidents efficiently.
Knowledge of Network Administration, including basic routing, switching, firewalls, and network monitoring tools.
Broad understanding of Information Technology concepts, architectures, and security best practices.
Proficiency in German (spoken and written) and good command of English for communication with international teams.
Experience with Microsoft and/or Linux server environments; familiarity with cloud technologies (public or private) is an advantage.
Ability to work systematically, document accurately, and follow ITIL or similar service management processes.
Relevant technical education or certification in IT (e.g., computer science degree, vocational training, or industry certifications) is beneficial.
Team-oriented mindset, reliability, and readiness to participate in shift work or on-call duties when required.
